repo_meta_data.description: Open-source (MIT) desktop app for managing MCP servers across Claude Desktop, Claude Code, Cursor, VS Code and Codex — health checks, tool safety scan, profiles, secrets and local backups. Native macOS (Swift) and Windows (.NET), no cloud, no telemetry.
